data.body: Decomposition complete against origin/main/ADR 0098: S1 cotton-only-cuckoo (application-wide shadow OperationSnapshot); S2 titanium-chocolatey-kakapo (reconciler read/check); S3 talismanic-profitable-isopod (apply/Git/child env); S4 distended-bipartisan-arkshell (RP-01 ProviderSession auth injection); S5 typical-neutral-waterbug (MCP/review-bot startup bindings); S6 ultrashort-immoderate-seriema (op-cert startup signer); S7 junior-lepidolite-boa (AST ownership gate, generated docs, canaries, legacy removal). Graph: S2->S1; S3->S2; S4->S1; S5->S4; S6->S1; S7->{S3,S5,S6}. Each child has binary behavioral ACs, RED->GREEN tiers/oracles, exact file impact, and expand/contract rollback. S1/S2/S4 use subsystem-local modules so S2, S4, and S6 can proceed conflict-free after S1. Blocked descendants will not be force-reviewed; they re-enter review when dependencies close.
